subject: Renewal: term amendment & spot capacity onboarding
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@stratusai.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurements@stratusai.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion: term amendment & spot capacity add-on
Attachments: Stratus_usage_report_Q2.csv (CSV)

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the partnership this past year. We're preparing for a heavier inference run in Q4 and want to discuss two things ahead of our renewal:

1) Temporary spot capacity: we'd like to add ~200 spot GPUs for a 3-month window (estimated start Sep 1).
2) Term amendment: we're open to extending the contract if we can get a blended unit price that reflects the additional capacity.

Can your team share a proposed amendment and the procurement paperwork (SOW/Amendment + SOC2 evidence) so we can align with our security and finance teams?

Also would like to block a short QBR to review usage patterns and onboarding for the temporary pool. We're available Jul 12–14 in the mornings PT.

Attached: Stratus_usage_report_Q2.csv (high level usage and expected spike).

Appreciate your help —
Sara Holt
Head of AI Ops, StratusAI

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: term amendment & spot capacity add-on
Attachments: amendment-draft-v1.pdf (PDF)

Sara — thanks for the heads up and the usage file, super helpful. We're excited to support the Q4 ramp. Proposed approach from our side:

- Near-term: create a 3-month spot pool (200 GPUs) that can be turned on Sep 1. We'll price it as a discounted burst add-on to avoid immediate commit changes.
- Mid-term: amend the renewal to extend the base term and fold a portion of the spot consumption into a committed block if you prefer lower unit pricing.
- Ops: Marissa will outline onboarding steps and runbook for activating the spot pool; Grace will confirm capacity availability across regions.

Can you confirm which of the Jul 12–14 morning windows works best for you? I can propose 30 minute slots: Jul 12 10:00am PT / Jul 13 9:00am PT / Jul 14 11:00am PT.

Marcus — can you draft two pricing paths (short-term spot add-on vs. 18-month blended term) and attach a draft amendment? I've attached a starting amendment draft (v1) for comments.

Attachments: amendment-pricing-v1.xlsx (XLSX)

Laura / team —

Attached is a first-pass pricing workbook. Two viable offers to present to Stratus:

A) Short-term spot add-on (no term change)
   - 200 spot GPUs for 3 months, billed monthly at spot-add rate (30% off list burst price)
   - Activation fee waived if signed by Aug 15
   - Minimal contractual change (simple SOW amendment)

B) Blended 18-month term extension
   - Extend base term by 6 months (total 18 months) and fold 50% of anticipated spot usage into a committed tier
   - Effective blended unit price ~18% lower than current committed rate
   - Requires amendment + revised payment schedule (typical 60-day procurement lead)

Recommendation: Lead with A to meet Sep 1 start, then convert to B in Q4 after actual usage telemetry. That preserves speed and gives procurement time for an 18-month amendment.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/RDW-5921 (use this to track approvals).

Sara / procurement team —

Thanks — based on our discussion and internal availability, here's the agreed next steps so we can hit a Sep 1 activation: 

1) Short-term: sign the simple SOW amendment for the 3-month 200 GPU spot pool (Option A). Marcus attached the pricing workbook.
2) Mid-term: we will convert to a blended amendment (Option B) if usage warrants; we'll prepare the 18-month amendment draft and route through DocuSign in mid-September.
3) Security & procurement: attached is the amendment draft (v1) and Marcus's pricing file. For SOC2 evidence, please use this link to our compliance pack: https://redwoodinference.sharepoint.com/compliance/SOC2 (I'll also send direct artifacts to your procurement mailbox).
4) QBR: confirmed Jul 12, 2027 at 10:00am PT — invite to follow. Agenda: usage review (Marissa), activation runbook (Marissa), pricing & timing (Marcus), security clearance items (Laura).
5) DocuSign: I will send the SOW amendment to the email procurements@stratusai.com once you confirm the acceptance of Option A. Draft DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-amendment

If procurement needs any custom language or an internal PO number added to the amendment, please reply with the PO and contact for signature.

Best —
Laura Bennett
